authorInfo.bio: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow (1807–1882) wrote The Song of Hiawatha: An Epic Poem. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.

description: "The Children's Own Longfellow" by Henry Wadsworth Longfellow is a collection of poems aimed at children, published in the early 20th century. This book encapsulates some of Longfellow's most beloved works, making them accessible and engaging for young readers.
